summary: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking be introduced on Wood Glen Road between Kingston Road to Anndale Road from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. Residents requested the implementation of overnight on-street permit parking on Wood Glen Road between Kingston Road and Anndale Road to accommodate their long-term parking needs.
decided: The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Amended Schedule A of City of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 925, Permit Parking, to authorize parking by permit only on a street name basis from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the even (west) side of Wood Glen Road, from Kingston Road to Anndale Road. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the east side of Wood Glen Road between Kingston Road and Anndale Road.
